Report: It will take three years for the US to replenish stockpiles of advanced weapons used in the Iran war.

Israel pushed a war of choice on the US that has dramatically weakened America's defences in other, more strategically vital areas.

 apnews.com/article/iran-war-…

Just a few years ago, the US assessment was that if Tehran were to mine the Strait of Hormuz, it would take the US no longer than 14 days to reopen it.

It has not been closed for 88 days. 

And there are no signs that the US has any military path to open it.

New US strikes on Iran. US says it was in response to Iranian drones being fired on ships in the Strait. Iranian position unclear. Also unclear whether there are casualties on the Iranian side.

It is unlikely IMO that Tehran will accept this as a new normal. Such a low grade conflict gives the US a major advantage: It can inflict comparability more damage on Iran while slowly eroding Iran's new-won deterrence.
